subject: sleepy alarm-clock mascot
art_direction: 矮胖机械闹钟揉着一侧钟铃，表盘无数字，指针像困倦眉毛，桃红与银色碰撞。
composition: one original central subject with a clear silhouette and circular-crop safe focal point
creative_direction: Make a squat mechanical alarm clock into a sleepy tin character. Its two top bells sit at uneven angles, and one short articulated arm rubs a bell as if rubbing an ear. Use an unnumbered cream clock face with small separate facial features; the simple hands angle like tired eyebrows without obscuring the eyes. The rose enamel casing contrasts with brushed silver hardware and dark feet. Photograph it on a desaturated navy field with broad soft light. No letters, numerals, sound marks, or repeated cartoon sparks appear. Square 1024x1024. Keep the complete central silhouette within a circular crop, occupying about 70% of the canvas. Original design; no lettering, logos, or watermark.
style_inspiration: Entirely original text-only concept, no IP characters, copied artwork, celebrity likeness or named artist imitation.
visual_review: passed: compressed preview inspected for distinct original concept, appealing silhouette and expression, requested medium, coherent shape/anatomy, clean visual hierarchy, no text or watermark
